items.mainDefect: verifySafeHtml() wraps IOException in an unchecked RuntimeException that escapes verify()'s declared MojoExecutionException/IOException handling and aborts the whole verifier.

secondary.defect: The English file path is derived textually ('resources-community'→'resources', locale→'_en') without checking it exists, so a valid message file can fail because its English sibling is missing.
